authority: Agent preparation choice under the owner's repeated instruction to choose and proceed autonomously, before first-wave model outputs. Not a separately signed human recipe approval, new source-use approval, or training launch.

decision_basis.background: Move the common code background to already-approved restricted Stack v3. Keep Stack-Edu as its existing E1S treatment and one half of the matched blend. Stack-Edu's present evidence does not support its former 1.2B nominal background capacity, particularly Java/TypeScript with all their released shards inspected. Restricted Stack v3 has a qualified complete-file acquisition path and additional pinned-source discovery path; its required supply still needs materialization and measurement. This is a source-capacity planning choice, not a quality nomination.
decision_basis.languages: Reduce Java 15% to 10% and TypeScript 10% to 6%, whose complete released Stack-Edu views fall short of the original E1S headroom estimates. Reassign nine percentage points across Python (+3), C++ (+1), Rust (+3), Shell (+1) and SQL (+1), retaining the application/systems emphasis and all eleven languages. The same fixed allocation applies to every code source, both halves of the equal blend, all shared code backgrounds and repetition pools. These supply-informed weights are not claimed optimal or selected from LM outcomes.
decision_basis.headroom: Keep 300M nominal / 360M headroom for the Stack-Edu treatment, and 1.2B nominal / 1.44B headroom for the new restricted Stack v3 background envelope. No quota is filled by another language's surplus. Point estimates above targets are not exclusion-qualified capacity or simultaneous confidence bounds.
decision_basis.selection: All three existing code treatments remain; no source wins the code comparison by becoming the preparation background. E2 and later architecture/integration controls are frozen through their existing registered stages. No tokenizer confirmation or D5 opening is required; Mistral stays frozen.

alternatives_considered.choice: retain former Stack-Edu background and language shares
alternatives_considered.reason: Current sampled yield does not support the larger background, and Java/TypeScript already fall short even for E1S headroom under the former shares.

alternatives_considered.choice: change language shares but retain Stack-Edu background
alternatives_considered.reason: The smaller E1S allocation still does not support four times as much Stack-Edu capacity under those shares; the shared-background constraint would remain.

alternatives_considered.choice: implicit background repetition, reduced code category, lower filtering, or new unapproved source
alternatives_considered.reason: Would change registered exposure/category or source-use/quality conditions; no such change is authorized by this preparation successor.

remaining_capacity_risk: Restricted Stack v3 currently has only 41,383,315 content/security-passing tokens before full exclusion in fourteen files. The new 1.44B background headroom is unfulfilled, not implied by this decision. Stack-Edu estimates likewise remain unqualified after full exclusion. A failing capacity gate stops materialization; any further allocation change requires another explicit pre-results successor. No automatic target relaxation, source swap, repetition, model launch or additional downloads.
